scripts.test: bun run test:fj && bun run --cwd packages/work-core test && bun run test:work-core-consumer && bun run test:job-attempt && bun run test:job-request && bun run test:session-event
scripts.test:work-core-consumer: bun run --cwd packages/work-core build && nu --no-config-file --no-history packages/work-core/test-consumer.nu .tmp/work-core-tests

scripts.typecheck:session-event: tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --target es2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node pi/extensions/shared/session-event.ts pi/extensions/shared/session-event.test.ts
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
